effective_date_basis: The order's own date is its effective date. The date of sale is a separate end date, from the Custodian's reports; if no report is held the end is an explicit gap, and the order date or a report year is only a not-earlier or not-later bound.
ending_pattern: The order authorizes one disposition of specified property seized under the Trading with the Enemy Act: a sale order is spent when the sale is completed; a rejection-of-bids order is spent when issued; a resale order is spent on the resale.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Title passed to the buyer is an accrued effect (state transferred_or_accrued). The proceeds stayed subject to the Settlement of War Claims Act of 1928 (the exemplar itself says so); treat that as a lead to check, not as independent of the order.

exemplar.wpa_summary: Alien Property Custodian authorized to sellat private sale certain specifiedstock of the U. S. Metals Refining Co., formerly the property of the Nationalbank fur Deutschland (Darmstadter und Nationalbank) of Berlin,Germany.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
The order prescribes general rules for the Custodian.
Not mapped to the 1921 war-end resolution: the Trading with the Enemy Act is reported to be excepted from it.
The authorized sale never took place, was cancelled, or was made at a different price or to a different buyer.
The property was returned to the claimant under the 1928 Act instead of being sold.
One order covers several properties sold on different dates: each needs its own end.
